body.fallback: Completing is permanent in Azure DevOps. Work items are not transitioned and branch policy is not bypassed. The source branch is deleted only if you chose that, and completion runs against the merge source shown here — if new commits arrive first, nothing is completed and you are asked again.

actions.description: Completes one active pull request with the branch decision the user chose, only while its merge source is still the commit they saw, and reports the polled terminal state rather than the accepted request.
actions.title: Complete an Azure DevOps pull request

body.fallback: The pull request stops being active and its reviewers stop being asked. Azure can reactivate it later, so this is not permanent.

actions.description: Abandons one active pull request. Azure can reactivate an abandoned pull request later.
actions.title: Abandon an Azure DevOps pull request

body.fallback: The pull request becomes active again and its reviewers are asked to look at it again. You can abandon it once more afterwards.

actions.description: Reactivates one abandoned pull request, which is Azure’s reopen. A completed pull request is refused rather than reactivated.
actions.title: Reactivate an Azure DevOps pull request

body.fallback: They are added as reviewers and notified. Nobody currently reviewing is removed and no existing vote is changed.

actions.description: Adds the selected identities as reviewers of one active pull request through one additive request, leaving every existing reviewer and vote untouched.
actions.title: Request review on an Azure DevOps pull request

body.fallback: Everyone on the pull request sees the new status. Nothing in the conversation is changed, and you can set the status again afterwards.

actions.description: Sets one review thread’s status and confirms it from the thread itself. The conversation in the thread is never rewritten.
actions.title: Set the status of an Azure DevOps review thread

body.fallback: Selected comments are published in order, then the verdict is submitted. If the pull request comparison moved, nothing is written.

actions.description: Publishes the selected canonical review comments in order and submits the viewer verdict last, only while the exact base and head remain current.
actions.title: Submit an Azure DevOps pull request review

body.fallback: This comment becomes visible as a new Azure DevOps review thread at the comparison you reviewed.

actions.description: Publishes one canonical Happier proposal as a new review thread at its exact preflighted Azure DevOps anchor.
actions.title: Publish an Azure DevOps pull request review comment

body.fallback: This reply becomes visible in the selected Azure DevOps review conversation.

actions.description: Publishes one canonical Happier proposal as a reply to the exact Azure DevOps thread and parent comment selected by the reader.
actions.title: Reply to an Azure DevOps pull request review thread

actions.description: Revalidates one selected pull request and materializes its source tip locally.
